The Cartier Revelation d'une Panthere (HPI01356) features a 37mm white gold case surrounding a diamond bezel and black, fluid filled dial with 650 diamonds that form a panther motif. This Cartier watch and its matching bracelet include a total of 1,289 diamonds. This timepiece is outfitted with a white gold diamond set bracelet and matching folding buckle. Functions include hours and minutes. This Cartier watch also measures 9.9mm in thickness and 39.5mm from lug-to-lug.
